name: Steamblower: RETALIATE
desc:
An anime-inspired open-world action RPG with high-octane combat to vent your frustrations.

Embark on an exhilarating journey:
- 🌎 Explore vast areas
- 📖 Follow the main-quests to progress the story
- 👊 Battle enemies you encounter to increase your Solace
- ⚔ Defeat powerful Bosses
- 🤝 Accept side-quests to raise your Bond with NPCs and receive rewards
- 🔓 Unlock new weapons to enhance your combos
- 💪 Spend Skill Points from leveling up to improve your stats
- ✨ Journey with your friends for a special bonus

A solo-developed passion project :)
